hero.heading: Let's Learn & Play! 🎉
hero.body: Hi there, superstar! 👋 Welcome to KiddoLearn — the most fun place to learn your ABCs, numbers, and meet amazing animals! Are you ready? Let's go! 🚀

category-cards.title: Alphabet
category-cards.desc: Learn all 26 letters! Hear how they sound and play letter games. A, B, C… let's go!

category-cards.title: Numbers
category-cards.desc: Count from 1 to 20! Tap the numbers, count the stars, and have a blast!

category-cards.title: Animals
category-cards.desc: Meet lions, penguins, frogs, and more! Learn their names and hear the sounds they make!

category-cards.title: Quizzes
category-cards.desc: Test what you know! Answer questions and win awesome badges! Can you get a perfect score?

category-cards-heading: What do you want to learn today? 🌈
category-cards-body: Pick a card and start your adventure! Every time you finish, you get a shiny star! ⭐

progress-tracker.label: Alphabet
progress-tracker.desc: Collect up to 26 stars, one for each letter you learn!

progress-tracker.label: Numbers
progress-tracker.desc: Collect up to 20 stars by counting your way to the top!

progress-tracker.label: Animals
progress-tracker.desc: Collect up to 12 stars by meeting all your animal friends!

progress-tracker.label: Quizzes
progress-tracker.desc: Collect up to 10 stars by acing every quiz!

progress-tracker-body: Every time you finish an activity, your star bar fills up! Keep going — you're doing amazing! 🌟

mascot-intro.heading: Meet Kiko! 🐨
mascot-intro.body: Hi! I'm Kiko the koala, and I'm your learning buddy! 🐨💛 I'll cheer for you, give you hints, and do a happy dance every time you get an answer right. Let's learn together — it's going to be SO much fun!

alphabet-header.heading: Let's Learn the ABC! 🎉
alphabet-header.body: Every letter is an adventure! Pick a letter below, listen to its sound, and play a fun game. You can do it! ⭐

letter-selector-body: Tap any letter to start learning it. Collect a star ⭐ for every letter you finish!

letter-game.desc: A big, bouncy letter pops up on your screen!
Three pictures appear. Which one starts with that letter?
Tap the picture you think is right!
Get it right and watch the confetti fly! 🎊
Wrong answer? No worries! Kiko the mascot gives you a hint!
Collect all your stars and become an Alphabet Champion! 🏆

letter-game-body: Look at the big letter. Then find the matching picture! Tap the right one and win a star. You've got this! 💪

audio-pronunciation.tip: Tap 🔊 to hear the letter name — like 'Ay' for A!
Tap 🔊 again to hear the letter sound — like 'Ah' for A!
Tap 🔊 to hear the example word — like 'Apple' for A!
Say it yourself — repeat after Kiko the mascot and practise!
Every letter has its own special sound — listen and learn them all!

audio-pronunciation-body: Tap the speaker button to hear how the letter sounds. Then say it out loud — you are a great reader! 📣

reward-animation.msg: You are on a roll! Amazing!

reward-animation-body: Woohoo! You finished a letter! Kiko is SO proud of you! Keep going and collect all 26 stars to become an Alphabet Superstar! 🌟

numbers-header.heading: Let's Count! 🔢
numbers-header.body: Numbers are so much fun! Pick a number, count along, and play games. You can do it — let's go! 🌟

number-selector.desc: Tap to count one shiny apple!
Tap to count two slow turtles!
Tap to count three bright stars!
Tap to count four jumping frogs!
Tap to count five yummy strawberries!
Tap to count six pretty butterflies!
Tap to count seven rainbow colours!
Tap to count eight wiggly octopus arms!
Tap to count nine pink flowers!
Tap to count ten bouncy balloons!
Tap to count eleven buzzy bees!
Tap to count twelve yummy cookies!
Tap to count thirteen colourful fish!
Tap to count fourteen sunny sunflowers!
Tap to count fifteen fluffy chicks!
Tap to count sixteen watermelon slices!
Tap to count seventeen magical unicorns!
Tap to count eighteen little trains!
Tap to count nineteen waddling penguins!
Tap to count twenty party hats — hooray!

number-selector-body: Tap any number to start learning it. Each one has a fun counting game just for you!

counting-game.tip: Tap the apples — how many can you count? 🍎
Touch each balloon as you count out loud! 🎈
Count the stars one by one — don't miss any! ⭐
Tap every frog to count them all! 🐸
Count the cookies — then eat them in your imagination! 🍪
Get it right and a big confetti shower falls down! 🎊

counting-game-body: Tap each thing on the screen to count it! When you reach the right number, you win a star! ⭐ Ready? Tap, tap, tap!

number-quiz.desc: Match the number to the picture (1–5) 🌟
Count the objects and pick the right number (1–10) 🔢
Letters, numbers, and animals all together! 🎉
Get 3 in a row right and win a shiny gold star! ⭐
Finish the whole quiz and unlock a special surprise badge! 🏅

number-quiz-body: How well do you know your numbers? Pick the right answer and earn a badge! Don't worry — you can try again as many times as you like! 😊

progress-badges.desc: Finished a number quiz without any mistakes!
Played the counting game 5 times — amazing!

progress-badges-body: Every number you learn gives you a star! Collect them all and become a Number Champion! 🏆

animals-header.heading: Meet the Animals! 🐾
animals-header.body: Wow, so many amazing animals to discover! Pick your favourite and learn cool things about it. You can even hear what it sounds like! 🎉

animal-grid.name: Lion
animal-grid.desc: the brave king of the jungle!

animal-grid.name: Giraffe
animal-grid.desc: the tallest animal in the world!

animal-grid.name: Penguin
animal-grid.desc: a funny bird that loves the cold!

animal-grid.name: Fox
animal-grid.desc: a clever and speedy little animal!

animal-grid.name: Turtle
animal-grid.desc: a slow and steady shell-wearing pal!

animal-grid.name: Butterfly
animal-grid.desc: a beautiful bug with colourful wings!

animal-grid.name: Frog
animal-grid.desc: a jumpy green friend who loves puddles!

animal-grid.name: Zebra
animal-grid.desc: a horse with cool black-and-white stripes!

animal-grid.name: Parrot
animal-grid.desc: a colourful bird that can copy your words!

animal-grid-body: Tap on any animal to learn all about it. There are so many cute ones to meet!

animal-detail.label: How big
animal-detail.value: Up to 2 metres long — that is really big!

animal-detail.label: Cool fact
animal-detail.value: Only male lions have a fluffy mane!

animal-detail.label: Fun fact
animal-detail.value: Lions sleep up to 20 hours every day!

animal-detail-body: The lion is a big, strong cat that lives in Africa. Lions have a fluffy mane around their face. They love to nap in the sun — up to 20 hours a day! Baby lions are called cubs. 🐾

fun-facts.fact: Giraffes have super long tongues — about 45 cm! They use them to grab leaves from tall trees.
Elephants can remember their friends for many, many years. They never forget!
Dolphins talk to each other using clicks and whistles. They are really chatty!
A butterfly tastes food with its feet! It has tiny taste sensors on its legs.
Penguins give pebbles to the ones they love. It is like a penguin gift!
Frogs drink water through their skin — they do not need to sip it!
Parrots can learn hundreds of words and even sing songs!
Some turtles can live for over 100 years — they are older than your great-grandparents!

fun-facts-body: Did you know these amazing things? Animals are SO cool! Tap a fact to see a fun picture! 🌈
animal-sounds-body: Press the big button to hear the animal's sound and its name! Can you make the sound too? 😄

quizzes-header.heading: Quiz Time! 🎉
quizzes-header.body: Can you answer all the questions? Pick a quiz and let's find out how much you know! You might even win a star! ⭐

quiz-selector.title: ABC Quiz
quiz-selector.desc: Can you match the letters? Test what you learned on the Alphabet page!

quiz-selector.title: Numbers Quiz
quiz-selector.desc: Count and pick the right number! Great for maths superstars!

quiz-selector.title: Animals Quiz
quiz-selector.desc: Do you know what sound a lion makes? Find out here!

quiz-selector.title: Big Mix Quiz
quiz-selector.desc: Letters, numbers, AND animals all in one! The ultimate challenge!

quiz-selector-body: Choose what you want to be quizzed on. Every quiz is super fun and has awesome rewards waiting for you!

quiz-game.question: How many legs does a spider have?
Which letter starts the word APPLE?
How many fingers do you have on one hand?
Which animal has a very long neck?
What letter does BALL start with?
Count the stars: ⭐⭐⭐⭐ — How many are there?

quiz-game-body: Read the question and tap the right answer! If you get it right, you'll see something really cool happen. No rush — take your time!

score-display.msg: WOW! You are a SUPERSTAR! 🌟🌟🌟 You got every single one right!
Amazing job! 🎉 You are SO close to perfect. Try again to get all 10!
Great try! 😊 You're learning so fast. Play again and beat your score!
Good start! 💪 Keep practising on the Alphabet, Numbers, and Animals pages and come back!

score-display-body: Here's your score! Every right answer gets you a star. See how many you collected!

reward-confetti.desc: Earned for finishing any quiz. You rock!
Earned for getting 10 out of 10. Incredible!
Earned for getting 5 correct answers in a row. On fire!
Earned for trying the Big Mix Quiz. So brave!

reward-confetti-body: Hooray! Confetti is falling just for YOU! You finished the quiz and that is something to celebrate. Collect your star badge and show everyone how clever you are!

items.fact: The English alphabet has 26 letters — 5 vowels and 21 consonants!
The word alphabet comes from the first two Greek letters: Alpha and Beta!
Every letter can be written in UPPERCASE and lowercase — that is 52 shapes to learn!
The ABC song was first published in 1835 and kids have been singing it ever since!

items.fact: A giraffe's tongue is dark blue and can be 45 cm long!
An octopus has three hearts and blue blood!
Butterflies taste with their feet — yummy!
Elephants are the only animals that cannot jump!
Sharks are older than dinosaurs — they have been around for 450 million years!
A bee visits up to 5,000 flowers in a single day!
